name: Days Innocent
source:
Mutsuki and Kaede are girl cousins who were very close at childhood  but have not met for almost 10 years because Kaede illness and transfer. Now Kaede joins other girls in the study and her heart flies to tender their wounds.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
